title: Back at Jia Nan Academy
summary: Xiao Yan returns after two years and is mocked as ordinary by students who wonder why Xun Er waited for him. Xue Beng, a Nine-Star Dou Shi with the Overlapping Waves Lance Skill, attacks first, and Xiao Yan beats him with one blow. Hu Jia, granddaughter of the vice dean Hu Qian, asks for a match with him, and the vice dean refuses her demand to expel him if she wins. Ruo Lin scolds Xiao Yan for his absence, and Xun Er promises they will both reach the top twenty so Ruo Lin can rise to instructor of the Xuan Class. Academy elders read his record against the Misty Cloud Sect and decide to watch him. That night Bai Shan, who uses lightning-type Dou Qi, tests him, and they agree to settle it at the competition. Xiao Yan tells Xun Er about his father, and she says her family's people have rules with the Xiao Clan, so it was not them, but she orders an investigation.
